text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among all the races held by the Three 
Goddesses so far, the SWBC gathered the 
truest elites. <chrname> narrowly suffered defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the Three Goddesses praise the 
achievements of having run this far.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, their race hadn't ended here. 
There was still one more goal they had to 
strive for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whether <chrname> had attained peak running form 
would be tested in the Grand Masters, 
running against the Three Goddesses.
